name: Faerie Dragon Muisek
summary: After the hippogryph spirits, Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants the spirit of a faerie dragon next. You are sent west to hunt sprite darters and sprite dragons and capture what makes them strong.

sections.title: Fragile Looks, Strong Spirit
sections.body: Uzer'i points out that faerie dragons seem delicate, yet their spirit is the real prize. They have been allies to the night elves, and Uzer'i wants the Horde to share in that strength. Uzer'i gives you a Muisek Vessel and sends you west to slay eight sprite darters or sprite dragons, then shrink and capture each fallen faerie dragon with it.

sections.title: Back at Uzer'i's Side
sections.body: When you return with the captured spirits, Uzer'i thanks you and says the faerie dragons' spiritual power is now there for the Horde to draw on. Uzer'i also hopes you will agree to one more job.

faq.q: Why does Witch Doctor Uzer'i want faerie dragon spirits?
faq.answer: Uzer'i says faerie dragons look fragile but hold a powerful spirit, and that they have been allies to the night elves. Uzer'i wants the Horde to benefit from that strength as well.

faq.q: Where can the faerie dragons be found?
faq.answer: Uzer'i says they lie west of where Uzer'i stands.

aliases: what do i kill for faerie dragon muisek
faq.answer: Sprite darters and sprite dragons. Eight of them need to be killed and captured.

faq.q: What must be done to the fallen creatures?
aliases: how to get faerie dragon muisek
faq.answer: The Muisek Vessel is used on each fallen faerie dragon to shrink it and capture its muisek.

faq.q: Where does this step fit among Uzer'i's requests?
aliases: what is next after faerie dragon muisek
faq.answer: It comes after Hippogryph Muisek, and Treant Muisek is the step that follows it.

attribution: Classic quest text: Faerie Dragon Muisek
